title: Founded, but almost nothing grew
happened: Built a full starter town on the flat map: avenue, 4 streets, homes, shops, factories, coal plant, 4 river pumps. But empty zones don't carry power, so only one edge of each zone had electricity and the city stayed at about 20 people.
watching: Whether the new power lines through the zones get buildings going.

title: Found the power problem
happened: Population stuck at 30 with 42% unemployment. Found that only zone tiles touching a power line were powered. Added two power lines through every zone row (x=84, x=92), linked to the plant.
watching: Growth now that every block has power.

title: Growth finally starts
happened: With power lines through the zones, population rose from 30 to 170. The pumps had no power, so water was 0%; ran a power line to them.

title: Slow climb
happened: Population 200 -> 480. Water reached 94%. Buildings only appear next to a power line or another building, so growth spreads slowly.

title: Jobs collapse
happened: Population 480 -> 640 but 45 buildings abandoned and 38% unemployment: shops and factories had no outside trade.
watching: Whether the neighbor link brings jobs back.

title: Neighbor link brings jobs
happened: Population passed 1,000 (640 -> 1,010). Shop and factory demand flipped from negative to full after the neighbor link.
watching: Water: pumps are starting to fall behind.

title: Growing, but water runs short
happened: Population 1,010 -> 1,350. Water coverage dropped to 48% and 64 buildings stood abandoned, many at the far east end. Cash only about $950: income is tiny at this size.
watching: Abandoned buildings once water is back.

title: Too few jobs, first loan
happened: Population 1,350 -> 1,450 but abandoned buildings rose to 94 and 38% had no job. Shops were over-built. Income was only about $57 a year, so took a $10,000 bond at 5%.
watching: Jobs from the new factory rows; homes in y29-34.

title: Borrowed and built
happened: Population 1,450 -> 2,430. The $10,000 bond paid for new homes, a whole factory district to the south and 10 river pumps. Unemployment fell from 38% to 28%.
watching: Jobs in the new factory district; shops are still over-built.

title: Fast growth
happened: Population 2,430 -> 3,120 (+28%). Abandoned buildings rose to 144: mostly small shops and factories turning over. Homes are almost full.
watching: Whether the new north housing district fills.

title: Slower than needed
happened: Population 3,120 -> 3,680. The new north homes started filling, but abandoned buildings kept rising (153) and 28% had no job.
watching: Why so many buildings empty out.

title: Found the real bottleneck: roads
happened: Only one north-south road (the west avenue) meant the east blocks were about 60 road tiles from jobs, too far for commuters. Two connector roads (x=88, x=102) fixed it: population 3,680 -> 5,310 (+44%), unemployment 28% -> 12%, abandoned 153 -> 84.

title: Ran unattended
happened: A bug in Claude's pause check let the game run on its own from early 2012 to early 2015. No changes were made in this year. Population kept climbing (5,310 -> 6,070 by Feb 2015) while water fell to 24% and the coal plant ran out of capacity.
watching: Water and power once Claude is back in control.

title: Ran unattended
happened: A bug in Claude's pause check let the game run on its own from early 2012 to early 2015. No changes were made in this year. Population kept climbing (5,310 -> 6,070 by Feb 2015) while water fell to 24% and the coal plant ran out of capacity.
watching: Water and power once Claude is back in control.

title: Water and power ran out
happened: Found the game had been running unattended. By Jan 2015: 6,070 people, water 24%, power plant maxed out, 160 abandoned buildings. Fixed the pause check, took a second $10,000 bond (4%), raised tax 3% -> 6%.
watching: New east district of dense homes.

title: Building out the east
happened: Population 6,070 -> 6,530. Dense homes in the east district started to rise slowly. Shop demand stayed maxed, with only 69 shop tiles in the whole city.
watching: Shops in the new east commercial rows; traffic (12 jammed tiles).

title: Slow year, money gone
happened: Population 6,530 -> 7,420 (+14%). Factory land was full while factory demand stayed maxed; 17% unemployed. Cash ran down to almost zero.
watching: Jobs from new factories; whether the bonds can be carried.

title: Second neighbor link pays off
happened: Population 7,420 -> 9,050 (+22%). The east neighbor link and the new factories helped; water fell to 53% again as the city grew.
watching: Water; unemployment stuck at 17% while factory demand stays maxed.
